node.name: Project-Global-Threat-Intelligence-Analysis-using-Cloud-Based-Honeypots
node.description: This project demonstrates the deployment of a T-Pot multi-honeypot system on Microsoft Azure to capture and analyze real-world cyber attacks in a controlled environment.  The honeypot was exposed to the internet for 24 hours, during which it recorded 266,000+ attack attempts, providing valuable insight into attacker behavior,exploited vulnerability

node.name: understanding-password-security
node.description: This repository analyzes password strength using The Password Meter. It demonstrates how different passwords score based on complexity rules and offers guidance on creating strong passwords.

node.name: Python-Web-Based-Vulnerability-Scanner
node.description: VulnScan is a lightweight, beginner-friendly vulnerability scanner built using Python, Flask, Nmap, and basic HTML/CSS for a simple web interface. It uses Nmap under the hood to scan ports and detect running services, displaying useful information in a clean, accessible UI.
